# costfluent_entitlement (Data Source)

Reads the account's plan and the limits it carries. An unset numeric limit means unlimited.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `band_plan_code` (String) The tier three months of measured spend puts this account in. Recorded, never applied.
- `currency` (String) Currency of the price and the spend ceiling.
- `current_period_end` (String) Exclusive end of the current billing period.
- `current_period_start` (String) First day of the current billing period.
- `features` (List of String) Everything the account's plan includes, plus anything granted to it.
- `history_days` (Number) How far back a cost query may reach.
- `ingestion_halted` (Boolean) Whether cost ingestion is paused for this account. Existing data and published reports stay readable while it is.
- `ingestion_halted_reason` (String) Why ingestion is paused. Empty when it is not.
- `max_allocation_rules` (Number) Allocation rules allowed across the account. Unset means unlimited.
- `max_backfill_months` (Number) How far back a first collection may reach.
- `max_bytes_stored` (Number) Provider payload bytes accepted per UTC month. Unset means unlimited.
- `max_connections` (Number) Provider connections allowed. Unset means unlimited.
- `max_rows_per_month` (Number) Cost rows accepted per UTC month. Unset means unlimited.
- `overridden_limits` (List of String) Limits this account deviates from its plan on.
- `plan_code` (String) The tier the account is on.
- `plan_name` (String) The tier's customer-facing name.
- `spend_ceiling` (Number) Tracked monthly spend the tier covers. Unset above Optimize.
- `status` (String) Free, Active, PastDue or Canceled.
